THE PRODUCT, SIMPLY

Same company.
Another side of the story.

Shares represent equity. Corporate bonds represent company debt. Their prices respond to interest rates, economic news and the issuer’s financial health.

BondTrader brings tokenised corporate bond trading into fractional sizes, with long and short positions and leverage available, subject to platform and instrument terms.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Who is the partner program for?

Creators, KOLs, educators, affiliates, publishers, introducing brokers and community owners who want to introduce bond trading to their audiences. Participation depends on program requirements and applicable eligibility rules.

Do I need to be a bond expert?

You can build educational content while learning about the market. Any content you publish should accurately explain the product and its risks, and follow the terms for your program.

What can my audience trade?

The starting focus is fractional tokenised corporate bonds, including instruments from NVIDIA and Alphabet/Google. Availability varies by route. Government bonds are not presented here as a live offering.

How are commissions calculated?

Commissions are based on qualifying referred trading activity under your agreed partner terms. Rates, qualifying volume, payment schedules and any exclusions are confirmed in your agreement. The calculator illustrates the arithmetic using a rate you supply.

Can I promote more than one program?

Your partnership can cover multiple agreed programs. Use the correct tracking link and current terms for each campaign, whether it introduces live trading, a challenge or an available promotion.

Is this the same as becoming a partner broker?

This page is for referral and distribution partnerships. Brokers interested in adding bond trading to their own offering should enquire through the broker route.
